transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We're here for the weekly enforcement review on the Northstar Systems royalty matter. As you know, their quarterly reports show inconsistent usage figures, and the commercial team wants this handled without disrupting the existing license. Before I can approve any enforcement plan, I need to hear concrete recommendations from each of our four specialists — finance, IP, privacy, and account counsel. I'll record each recommendation in the enforcement checklist, and once all four have stated their positions, I'll make the final call. Let's start with finance — what's your recommendation?
